text:
maya: Heads-up: nightly e2e gate (longseq) red — p95 jumped to ~420ms on the runner. Failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/2842. Anyone can quick triage? I think it's warmup/noise.

ci-bot: CI job nightly-longseq/2842 failed: p95 420ms > baseline 120ms. Artifacts: gs://builds/nightly/2842/logs.tar.gz

kevin: is this the same cluster as last night's spike? If so could be kv-cache invalidation from #5192. @maya which commit range did this pick up?

maya: Triggered on commit 9a7f3c5 -> 2b1d8a0 (merged PR 5301). PR touched batching/packets. tag: longseq-suite/nightly

aj: I can take a quick rerun with only the longseq subset and `--warmup=400` turned off. If it's warmup, it should smooth out. Will queue.

sara: Before rerunning, can someone paste the runner logs around the first 30s? suspecting large GC in the worker (seen earlier). If rerun passes mark flaky and we'll bisect.

maya: snippet from logs:
```
[00:11] kv_cache: miss rate 0.87
[00:13] batching: flush batch_size=1
[00:20] p95=420ms p99=710ms
```
Looks like kv cache cold and tiny batches.

aj: Rerun queued: `ci-bot rerun nightly-longseq --subset longseq-only --note 'warmup check'`
ci-bot says position 2 in queue.

build-bot: Queue update: backlog=3, your job queued at pos=2, est start ~4m.

kevin: If rerun passes, we should still bisect PRs touching batching. Assigning to @sara for a quick bisect next window.

sara: On it. If rerun passes I'll start a binary search across commits 9a7f3c5..2b1d8a0 tomorrow morning and post bisect gist.

ci-bot: Rerun complete: p95=128ms p99=190ms — PASS. Marking original run flaky. Tracking ticket: INF-721

maya: :thumbsup: OK marking flaky and closing immediate alert. Sara, thanks—please post bisect results if you find a root cause.
